name: rep-deck
description: A modern strength-training tracker built with Next.js 16, TypeScript 7, Tailwind v4, and Drizzle. Log workouts, track PRs, and visualize your progress.

paragraphs: Rep Deck is a strength-training tracker built for lifters who care about raw progression — load, volume, intensity, and consistency. Log every set, maintain versioned training plans, monitor body composition, and track estimated 1RM trends across time. Every write goes through a Server Action; every read is a typed Drizzle query. No spreadsheets.
features: Workout Logging — Sets are logged with weight, reps, and RPE. Your active program pre-fills targets, and last session's numbers render inline beside each input via a batched performance lookup…

Session Date Picker — Log a workout on any past date, not just today. If you missed Tuesday, open the app Wednesday, pick Tuesday in the date picker, and the app auto-switches to Tuesday's scheduled workout. The session…

Weekday Anchoring — Optionally anchor a plan to a calendar weekday (e.g. "Day 1 starts on Monday"). Every day in the plan derives its weekday by offset, and the workout log auto-selects today's scheduled day on load.…

Versioned Programs — Duplicate a program template to fork it into a new version (v1 → v2) with the full day/exercise hierarchy preserved. Deleting a program uses ON DELETE SET NULL on workoutSessions.programId, so…
Day Management — Create, rename, duplicate, and delete training days. Deleting a day reindexes the remaining days in a transaction so Day 1, 2, 3… stay contiguous and can't collide on add.
